name: radare2-mcp
description: An MCP server for radare2, providing powerful binary analysis tools for AI agents.
author: pancake

R2MCP_PORT.description: The port for the radare2-mcp HTTP server.

invocationCommands.description:
Opens a binary file with radare2 for analysis. Call this tool before any other one. Use an absolute file_path.
参数:
- file_path (字符串, 必需): 要打开的文件路径。
调用格式:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」radare2-mcp「末」,
command:「始」open_file「末」,
file_path:「始」/path/to/binary「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」radare2-mcp「末」,
command:「始」open_file「末」,
file_path:「始」/bin/ls「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

invocationCommands.description:
Lists all functions found in the current binary.
参数:
- only_named (布尔, 可选): 仅列出有名字的函数 (默认为 false)。
- count (布尔, 可选): 仅返回函数个数 (默认为 false)。
- filter (字符串, 可选): 使用正则过滤函数名。
调用格式:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」radare2-mcp「末」,
command:「始」list_functions「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

Gets the disassembly of a function or at a specific address.
参数:
- address (字符串, 可选): 函数名或起始地址。
- lines (整数, 可选): 打印的行数 (缺省时打印整个函数)。
调用格式:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」radare2-mcp「末」,
command:「始」get_disassembly「末」,
address:「始」main「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」radare2-mcp「末」,
command:「始」get_disassembly「末」,
address:「始」0x00401000「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

invocationCommands.description:
Runs a raw radare2 command. This is a powerful tool, use with caution.
参数:
- command (字符串, 必需): 要运行的 r2 命令。
调用格式:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」radare2-mcp「末」,
command:「始」run_command「末」,
command_str:「始」px 64「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」radare2-mcp「末」,
command:「始」run_command「末」,
command_str:「始」iI「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
